## 4.0-S3b (S3 grammar completed)

**Keyword arguments (§4.6.1):** `f(pos, name := expr)` — parsed as `KeywordArgumentNode`, statically expanded in `ResolveFunctionCall` against a new `FunctionLibrary.KeywordSignatures` table (names/defaults verified line-by-line against the live F&O 4.0 draft; 21 functions covered). No-namespace keywords; unknown/duplicate/misordered → XPST0017/XPST0003 per spec; unfilled optionals take spec defaults; rewrite to positional at the fully-populated arity. Arrow targets compose (source counts as first positional). Bonus per draft: `fn:substring#3`/`fn:subsequence#3` accept empty `$length` (to-end) in 4.0 mode only. Recorded follow-ups: full signature population, variadic keywords, XQuery forms. (qt4tests keyword-args set is withdrawn upstream — hand-written tests only.)

**String templates (§4.10.2):** backtick templates with `{expr}` interpolation — single lexer token with longest-token `{{ `/`}}`/backtick escapes, interpolation-aware rescan, lowering through the XQuery string-constructor parts-join (identical semantics). 3.1 mode unchanged (backtick was always invalid).

## Gates

- Build 0 errors; unit all green (+22 tests, Api.Tests 165); QT3 **exactly 31,142/0/679**; XSLT targeted smoke 162/0/26 identical
- **Full XSLT sweeps (basic + schema-aware) run by the parent before merge — parser/compiler files touched.**

Docs synced: FEATURE_REQUESTS (S3b row), INTEGRATION §0, AGENT_HANDOVER fifty-eighth session.
title: feat(xpath40): REQ-118 4.0-S3b — keyword arguments + string templates
